description: This file defines an abstract class 'Command' within the OrangeHRM project, extending Symfony's console command class. It provides encapsulation for IO operations and enforces implementation of a command name in subclasses.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: An abstract class extending Symfony's Command, providing common IO handling and enforcing a command name specification for subclasses.

methods.name: getIO
methods.description: Returns the SymfonyStyle object for IO interactions.

methods.name: setIO
methods.description: Initializes the IO style object using provided input and output interfaces.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Sets up IO and delegates execution to the parent run method.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Abstract method that must be implemented by subclasses to specify the command name.
